description: Defines the LogicalNode class representing logical operators (AND, OR, NOT) in an abstract syntax tree, including nested types, constructors, and visitor pattern implementation.

classes.name: LogicalNode
classes.description: Represents a logical operation node (AND, OR, NOT) in an abstract syntax tree with support for visitor pattern, equality, and hashing.

classes.name: LogicalNode.Type
classes.description: Enumeration of logical node types: AND, OR, NOT, with methods for name-based lookup.

methods.name: LogicalNode(String name)
methods.description: Constructs a LogicalNode with a specified name, inferring type from name.

methods.name: LogicalNode(Type type)
methods.description: Constructs a LogicalNode with a specified type.

methods.name: LogicalNode(Type type, Node... subNodes)
methods.description: Constructs a LogicalNode with a specified type and child nodes.

methods.name: LogicalNode(Type type, Collection<Node> subNodes)
methods.description: Constructs a LogicalNode with a specified type and collection of child nodes.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the logical node.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the logical node.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a PredicateVisitor to process this node.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the LogicalNode.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on name and type.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on name and type.
